extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts from 'Net loss' of $(3,898) per the FFO, Core FFO and AFFO table (page 16). The Financial Summary on page 6 shows net loss attributable to common stockholders of (3,883), a different figure; the reconciliation's own starting line was used. All subtotals foot: -3,898 + 23,266 - 73 = 19,295; 19,295 + adjustments = 18,613; 18,613 + adjustments = 21,008. Diluted shares 26,075 reproduce reported per-share figures: 19,295/26,075 = 0.74, 18,613/26,075 = 0.71, 21,008/26,075 = 0.81. Recurring capex of 2,680 (quarter) taken from the Historical Capital Expenditures table on page 17 because AFFO here does not subtract it; that table does not state a company-share scope. Q1 2022 column ignored.
